description: This file defines inline functions for integrity protection algorithms (NIA1, NIA2, NIA3) and a verification function for short MACs, used in security protocols within the ocudu security namespace.

methods.name: security_nia1
methods.description: Implements the NIA1 integrity algorithm, copying the message buffer to contiguous memory and calling s3g_f9.

methods.name: security_nia2_cmac
methods.description: Performs CMAC-based NIA2 integrity calculation using mbedtls cipher functions.

methods.name: security_nia2_non_cmac
methods.description: Performs NIA2 integrity calculation without CMAC, using AES ECB mode and subkey generation.

methods.name: security_nia2
methods.description: Selects between CMAC and non-CMAC NIA2 implementation based on compile-time flag.

methods.name: GET_WORD
methods.description: Extracts a 32-bit word from a data array with bit offset handling.

methods.name: security_nia3
methods.description: Implements the NIA3 integrity algorithm, generating a MAC using ZUC stream cipher and message bits.

methods.name: verify_short_mac
methods.description: Verifies a received short MAC against expected value computed with specified integrity algorithm and configuration.
